title: A/H低开后结构分化：长风药业与信科移动获正反馈，天齐锂业A/H承压
summary: 截至11月25日09:43 CST，上证指数跌0.71%、创业板指跌1.19%，隔夜科技回吐与弱宽度继续压制风险偏好。长风药业涨2.93%至4.565港元、信科移动涨1.80%至9.62元，获得初步但有限的公告后价格确认；天齐锂业A/H分别跌1.40%和1.17%，关联锂矿收购未获价格确认并转为回避。微创机器人-B延迟行情暂无成交，神雾节能停牌，均不作多头确认；08:42后未发现改变主线的新增重大政策或公告。

美股夜盘行情总结

指数背离
指数背离
11月24日道指涨0.85%，标普跌0.50%，纳指跌1.48%；价值与防御承接，不能把道指走强外推为全面风险偏好回升。
板块分化
板块分化
百货与生物科技涨逾6%，计算机硬件、半导体与电子元件跌5.93%至8.17%；四项医药概念进入前五，防御轮动强于AI硬件。
A/H映射
A/H映射
美股硬件与半导体下挫对A/H科技构成负面映射，上证与创业板开盘后分别跌0.71%和1.19%；长风药业、信科移动获有限正反馈，天齐锂业A/H同步承压。

盘前结论

事实：09:43上证跌0.71%、创业板跌1.19%，隔夜科技回吐的负面映射仍在。

判断：长风药业与信科移动获得初步正反馈但仍需持续相对强势；天齐锂业A/H同步下跌，转为回避。

不确定性：微创机器人-B延迟行情暂无成交，神雾节能停牌；不把无成交或停牌写成实时买点。

重点个股关注

微创机器人-B
02252.HK
条件关注
事实与状态：图迈订单突破400台，中国年内37台、海外超过200台；截至09:43延迟行情暂无成交，仍无公告后有效价格确认。 来源
确认条件：开盘后相对恒生医疗与机器人同业强势，且交付、装机、收入确认和回款验证订单质量。
风险与失效条件：订单不等于收入；若高开回落、持续弱于同业或装机回款滞后，取消关注。
长风药业
02652.HK
初步确认
事实与状态：ICF001获FDA许可推进I期；09:43报4.565港元、涨2.93%，获得初步但有限的公告后价格确认。 来源
确认条件：开盘后相对港股创新药同业走强，且I期启动、入组与安全性数据按计划推进。
风险与失效条件：I期不等于有效性或上市批准；若弱于同业或临床延迟，取消关注。
信科移动
688387.SH
初步确认
事实与状态：控股股东增持200万股、成交1899.07万元，计划六个月内增持不超过2亿元；09:43报9.62元、涨1.80%，相对大盘获得初步正反馈。 来源
确认条件：今日开盘后保持相对通信设备板块强势，且后续增持持续发生并披露。
风险与失效条件：上限不等于必然完成；若放量跌破公告前收盘或增持不执行，取消关注。
天齐锂业
002466.SZ / 09696.HK
回避
事实与状态：拟现金收购天齐兴宇100%和润丰矿业76.5269%；09:43 A股报31.75元、跌1.40%，H股报20.20港元、跌1.17%，双市场均未确认收购事件。 来源
重新评估条件：A/H两地相对锂矿同业止跌转强，并披露公允定价、资金来源和开发时间表。
风险与失效条件：关联交易、现金支出、矿权兑现与锂价风险并存；若继续弱于同业则转为回避。
神雾节能
000820.SZ
回避
事实与状态：监管告知书指向2024年年报虚假记载，公司11月25日停牌并拟实施其他风险警示；停牌无有效报价。 来源
重新评估条件：正式处罚、财务更正、内控整改和持续经营影响充分披露，复牌后价格与流动性稳定。
风险与失效条件：会计、治理、索赔与退市相关风险优先，在整改和复牌验证前维持回避。

板块轮动看板

结构线索

百货、生物科技及医药概念领涨，美股从AI硬件转向防御与传统消费。

本地支点

央行流动性、北斗规则，以及机器人、医药与通信事件提供结构线索。

压力方向

美股硬件、半导体与元件显著下跌，A股宽度偏弱、恒生科技下跌。

验证信号

观察长风与信科移动能否维持相对强势、微创机器人能否形成有效成交，以及锂交易定价和增持执行。

逻辑链

纳指-1.48%且半导体行业-6.67% → AI硬件回吐 → A/H芯片、服务器与电子元件先防守而非追涨。
百货和生物技术涨逾6%、四项医药概念进前五 → 防御轮动 → 医药事件需本地同业与公告后价格确认。
8000亿元MLF + 5000亿元逆回购 → 流动性支撑 → 有助稳定大盘，但不能抵消3498家下跌的弱宽度。
开盘反馈分化 → 长风药业与信科移动获有限正反馈，天齐锂业A/H同步下跌，微创机器人暂无成交 → 初步确认、条件关注与回避进一步分流。

风险雷达

美股硬件、半导体、电子元件和半导体设备跌幅均超过5%，A/H科技映射可能继续承压。
A股11月24日下跌家数3498家，指数小涨不代表多数股票风险偏好改善。
天齐锂业为关联现金收购，定价、资金和矿权兑现均需后续披露。
神雾节能与大烨智能面临年报虚假记载及风险警示，会计与治理风险优先。
机器人订单和临床许可不等于当期收入或最终商业成功；长风药业的初步上涨仍可能回吐，微创机器人暂无有效成交。

数据来源与时间点

增量扫描截至2026-11-25 09:43 CST；08:42后未发现改变主线的新增重大政策或公告。发现源为上证报/东方财富与第一财经，原始核验覆盖人民银行、工信部、上交所及港交所；行情基线为AKShare 11月24日收盘快照，美股排行抓取于08:34 CST；开盘反馈来自东方财富延迟行情，微创机器人无成交、神雾节能停牌均显式披露。

Major News
Global
US equities split sharply between the Dow and technology
On Nov 24 the Dow rose 0.85% to 50,018.70, while the S&P 500 fell 0.50% and the Nasdaq lost 1.48%. Technology gave back gains as defensive and old-economy shares outperformed. Source
Ranking
Department stores and biotech led while hardware and chips lagged
The 08:34 CST snapshot showed department stores and biotechnology up 6.16% and 6.01%. Computer hardware, semiconductors, electronic components and semiconductor equipment fell 8.17%, 6.67%, 5.93% and 5.81%. Four of the five leading concepts were healthcare-related. Source

MIIT sought comments on BeiDou short-message service rules

Market

On Nov 24 Shanghai rose 0.27% and STAR 50 gained 1.81%, while ChiNext slipped 0.05%. A-shares had 1,951 gainers and 3,498 decliners; HSI, HSCEI and Hang Seng TECH fell 0.80%, 1.08% and 1.24%. Source

The company proposed cash acquisitions of 100% of Tianqi Xingyu and 76.5269% of Runfeng Mining. Related-party valuation, funding and resource conversion are counterevidence. At 09:43 CST the A-share was down 1.40% at RMB31.75 and the H-share down 1.17% at HKD20.20, so neither listing confirmed the event. Source

MicroPort MedBot's Toumai global commercial orders exceeded 400 units
China added 37 orders this year and overseas orders exceeded 200 across more than 70 countries and regions. Orders are not current revenue; delivery and collections need verification, and no valid post-event session has begun. Source

CICT Group bought 2 million shares for RMB18.9907 million and plans further purchases within six months capped at RMB200 million. At 09:43 CST it traded at RMB9.62, up 1.80% versus a 0.71% Shanghai Composite decline, providing initial positive feedback. Source
Risk
Shenwu Energy Saving and Daye Intelligent faced special-treatment warnings
Regulatory notices cited false historical annual reports. Both companies are suspended Nov 25 and expected to resume Nov 26 under special-treatment warnings. Source

US Overnight Trading Summary

Index divergence
Index divergence
On Nov 24 the Dow rose 0.85%, the S&P fell 0.50% and the Nasdaq lost 1.48%. Value and defensive shares found support, so Dow strength does not confirm a broad risk-on move.
Sector split
Sector split
Department stores and biotech gained more than 6%, while computer hardware, semiconductors and components fell 5.93%–8.17%. Four healthcare concepts reached the top five, showing defensive rotation over AI hardware.
A/H mapping
A/H mapping
US hardware and semiconductor losses mapped negatively into A/H technology, with Shanghai and ChiNext down 0.71% and 1.19%. CF PharmTech and CICT Mobile received limited positive feedback, while Tianqi weakened in both listings.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: at 09:43 CST Shanghai was down 0.71% and ChiNext down 1.19%, so the overnight technology selloff still had a negative read-through.

View: CF PharmTech and CICT Mobile received initial positive feedback but still require sustained relative strength; Tianqi weakened in both listings and moves to avoid.

Uncertainty: MicroPort MedBot-B had no delayed trade and Shenwu was suspended; neither no-trade nor suspension is a live entry point.

Stocks to Watch

MicroPort MedBot-B
02252.HK
Conditional watch
Fact and status: Toumai orders exceeded 400 units, with 37 in China this year and more than 200 overseas. At 09:43 CST the delayed quote showed no trade, so valid post-event price confirmation remains unavailable. Source
Confirmation: outperform Hong Kong healthcare and robotics peers after the open, with delivery, installation, revenue recognition and collections validating order quality.
Risk and invalidation: orders are not revenue; cancel if the stock fades, lags peers, or installation and collections fall behind.
CF PharmTech
02652.HK
Initial confirmation
Fact and status: ICF001 received FDA clearance to proceed into Phase I. At 09:43 CST it traded at HKD4.565, up 2.93%, an initial but limited post-event confirmation. Source
Confirmation: outperform Hong Kong biotech peers after the open, followed by timely Phase I initiation, enrollment and safety data.
Risk and invalidation: Phase I is not efficacy or approval; cancel if price lags peers or clinical progress slips.
CICT Mobile
688387.SH
Initial confirmation
Fact and status: the controller bought 2 million shares for RMB18.9907 million and plans up to RMB200 million more within six months. At 09:43 CST it traded at RMB9.62, up 1.80% versus a 0.71% Shanghai decline, providing initial positive feedback. Source
Confirmation: maintain relative strength versus communications-equipment peers after today's open, with continued disclosed purchases.
Risk and invalidation: the cap is not guaranteed execution; cancel if price breaks the pre-event close on volume or purchases do not continue.
Tianqi Lithium
002466.SZ / 09696.HK
Avoid
Fact and status: proposed cash acquisitions of 100% of Tianqi Xingyu and 76.5269% of Runfeng Mining. At 09:43 CST the A-share was down 1.40% at RMB31.75 and the H-share down 1.17% at HKD20.20, so neither listing confirmed the event. Source
Reassessment: both listings stabilize and outperform lithium peers, with fair valuation, funding and a development timetable disclosed.
Risk and invalidation: related-party valuation, cash outlay, mining execution and lithium-price risk remain; move to avoid if both listings lag peers.
Shenwu Energy Saving
000820.SZ
Avoid
Fact and status: a regulatory notice cited false 2024 annual-report records. Trading is suspended Nov 25 ahead of a special-treatment warning, so no valid quote exists. Source
Reassessment: final sanctions, restatement, remediation and going-concern effects are disclosed, followed by stable post-resumption price and liquidity.
Risk and invalidation: accounting, governance, claims and delisting-related risks dominate; remain avoid until remediation and post-resumption validation.

Sector Rotation Board

Structural leads

Department stores, biotech and healthcare led as US rotation moved away from AI hardware.

Local supports

PBOC liquidity, BeiDou rules, and robotics, drug and communications events offer selective catalysts.

Pressure points

US hardware, semiconductors and components fell sharply amid weak A-share breadth and lower Hang Seng TECH.

Signals to verify

Watch whether CF PharmTech and CICT Mobile sustain relative strength, MicroPort develops a valid trade, and lithium valuation and purchases are executed.

Logic Chain

Nasdaq -1.48% and semiconductors -6.67% → AI hardware gave back → treat A/H chips, servers and components defensively rather than chase.
Department stores and biotech gained over 6%, with four healthcare concepts in the top five → defensive rotation → local peer and post-event price confirmation is required.
RMB800bn MLF + RMB500bn reverse repo → liquidity support → helpful for stability but not enough to erase 3,498 decliners.
Opening feedback diverged → CF PharmTech and CICT Mobile gained limited confirmation, Tianqi fell in both listings, and MicroPort had no trade → split into initial confirmation, conditional watch and avoid.

Risk Radar

US hardware, semiconductors, components and chip equipment each fell more than 5%, pressuring A/H technology read-throughs.
A-shares had 3,498 decliners on Nov 24, so modest index gains did not represent broad risk improvement.
Tianqi's related-party cash acquisition still needs disclosure on valuation, funding and mining execution.
Shenwu and Daye face false-report and special-treatment issues, making accounting and governance risks dominant.
Robot orders and a clinical-study clearance do not equal current revenue or eventual success; CF PharmTech’s initial gain can fade and MicroPort still lacks a valid trade.

Discovery sources were Shanghai Securities News/Eastmoney and Yicai, with primary checks against PBOC, MIIT, SSE and HKEX. The baseline is the AKShare Nov 24 close snapshot and US rankings fetched at 08:34 CST; opening feedback uses Eastmoney delayed quotes, with MicroPort’s no-trade and Shenwu’s suspension disclosed.
